summary: Full backend (31/31 pytest) + full frontend (23/23 UI assertions) end-to-end suite for the İhracat Bedeli Kapatma sistemi. Auth (5 roles), RBAC on declarations/payments/matches/users, TCMB cross-currency matching, partial/over-limit validation, match update/delete recalculation, block-delete when matched, dashboard KPIs, audit log, reports summary and Excel export all pass. UI verified for admin/ihracat/banka/sef with role visibility, redirects for /kullanicilar, duplicate beyanname error toast, match preview and over-limit toast.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS is '*' while allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed requests for wildcard origins. Works via Bearer fallback but breaks cookie-only clients. Set explicit origins in production.
No brute-force lockout implemented (spec mentions 5-fail lockout in playbook_testing_instructions). Currently unlimited attempts return 401.
Any authenticated user (including viewer) can list all users including emails. Consider restricting to admin.

action_items: Optional: replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit preview/prod origin list to allow cookie-based auth without Bearer fallback.
Optional: add basic brute-force lockout (5 failed logins → temp block) to satisfy hardening guidance.
Optional: restrict GET /api/users to admin (currently readable by any authenticated role).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L561: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is a spec violation; specify explicit origins.
server.py L190 list_users has no role guard; other listers (declarations/payments/audit-logs) are intentionally open per spec, but users list leaks PII.
MatchDialog editMatch uses window.prompt (L103) — not accessible/mobile-friendly; consider inline input form. Minor UX.

tcmb.get_rates caches by base date, not by kur_tarihi. If two different tescil dates fall to the same previous business day, second call still keys off original date — fine but note kur_tarihi may vary.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_/UI_TEST_ prefixed records were created and cleaned up during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers auth, RBAC per role, declarations CRUD + duplicate, payments CRUD, matches (same/cross currency via TCMB), over-declaration and over-payment limits, update/delete match recalculation, block-delete when matched, dashboard, audit, reports summary, Excel export, users admin-only. UI flow tests are inline in the playwright run and use data-testids already present in the codebase. Both suites are green.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects; all requested features work as specified.
